caveats: The room, microphone, background hiss and MP3 stages are whatever helps the fit match; they aren't a measurement of the real room or microphone.
These are the nine notes the fit learned from. Notes it never heard score about as well, but aren't drawn here.
The dry switch plays the banjo alone, without the recording chain.
Each note is played at the same loudness, so the plate compares sound, not level.
The recordings themselves aren't reproduced here: their licence doesn't allow sharing them as they are. The blue curve is their spectrum.

stages.name: Allway zero-start fit
stages.what: The banjo and the recording chain it is heard through are fitted together, starting from a chain that does nothing.

glossary.string_t60: Amplitude T60 in seconds derived as ln(1000)/decay_rate, interpolating rates in log frequency; a string-loop target, not the measured decay of the complete sound.
glossary.stiffness_b: Unused additional stiff-string coordinate; the fitted allpass controls below model dispersion in this deployable render.
glossary.pick_position: Pluck distance from the bridge divided by the vibrating string length; per-note excitation-comb position.
glossary.pick_width_ms: Width parameter of the exponential pick pulse in milliseconds, twice its continuous-time decay constant; longer is rounder.
glossary.pick_corner_hz: Lowpass corner parameter of the pick pulse; lower is a softer, rounder pluck.
glossary.level: Trainable per-note amplitude multiplier after the fixed initial loudness scale; listening and spectrum assets are separately normalized to 0.05 RMS.
glossary.detune_cents: Per-note pitch correction in cents relative to the measured reference fundamental; not relative to equal temperament.
glossary.glide_cents: Initial pitch-glide amplitude in cents, relaxing exponentially with a separately fitted time constant.
glossary.noise: Per-note amplitude multiplier for a deterministic unit-RMS colored noise burst, multiplied by 0.001 before level and the fixed initial loudness scale; not a measured noise fraction.
glossary.mode_hz: Frequency of a fitted series-body resonator; (m,n) identifies its initial ideal-membrane Bessel mode, not a measured physical head mode.
glossary.mode_t60_s: Amplitude T60 of a series-body resonator in seconds, bounded to 0.015–1 second; driving strings can extend the audible tail.
glossary.mode_gain: Positive relative weight of a series-body biquad, initialized relative to the head fundamental; not displacement or an independently identified radiation efficiency.
glossary.spectrum: First 0.5 s, Hann-windowed magnitude, RMS-smoothed into 200 logarithmic bands; dB relative to that reference note’s unsmoothed spectral peak, with each full two-second probe at 0.05 RMS.
glossary.partials: Measured spectral-peak frequencies from the same 0.5-s window within ±0.35 fundamental of each of the first 16 harmonics; null means no local peak above 1% of the note’s strongest spectral magnitude.
glossary.room_early: Signed reflection amplitudes at 331, 619, 1061 and 1777 samples, each bounded to ±0.08 relative to the unit direct impulse. Zero is no reflection.
glossary.room_wet: Signed amplitude of the seeded two-band late field, bounded to ±0.15; zero is no late field and the sign is a nuisance phase choice, not a room measurement.
glossary.room_t60_s: Two late-field amplitude T60s bounded to 0.04–0.30 seconds; low band below approximately 1.8 kHz. It has no effect while late-field amplitude is zero.
glossary.mic_db: Realized 129-tap FIR response at 300, 600, 1000, 2000, 4000, 9000 and 22050 Hz. The mean realized dB on 256 log-spaced frequencies from 300 to 22050 Hz fixes the gauge; zero means identity.
glossary.mic_response: Realized 129-tap FIR response on 256 log-spaced frequencies from 300 to 22050 Hz; arithmetic mean dB is zero.
glossary.background_db: 20 log10 of the absolute signed amplitude multiplier on the measured pre-onset PSD, with a finite −240 dB display floor at exact zero. This is relative to the measured background, not an absolute noise level.
glossary.background_amplitude: Signed amplitude multiplier on the measured pre-onset noise realization, bounded to ±1. It is exactly zero at step 0.
glossary.background_power_scale: Square of background_amplitude: the power multiplier on the measured pre-onset PSD, bounded to 0–1 and exactly zero at step 0.
glossary.codec_fraction: Signed signal-shaped codec-noise amplitude fraction, bounded to ±0.01. Zero means no proxy noise.
glossary.codec_rolloff: Signed blend weight for the fixed high-frequency codec rolloff, bounded to ±1. Zero is flat response; +1 applies the full rolloff curve.
glossary.dispersion_stages: Three fitted allpass reflection coefficients per string, each bounded to −0.98–0; these controls model string dispersion in the deployable render.
glossary.polarization_detune_cents: Second-polarization detuning per string, bounded to ±8 cents.
glossary.polarization_mix: Second-polarization amplitude mix per note, bounded to 0–0.5.

audio_variants.audio: as recorded through the fitted room, mic, measured background and codec proxy
audio_variants.dry_audio: instrument only, with all recording stages disabled
